    Simulated qPCR experiment

    Source: R/data.R
    qpcr_sim.Rd

    Simulated data. Ct values for an E. coli heat-shock experiment with two reference genes (gapA, rpoD) and four targets, three treatments, four biological samples per treatment and three technical replicates per sample, run on two plates. Ct values were generated in data-raw/make_data.R from known log2 fold changes (control 0; heat 42 C: dnaK 3, groL 2, ibpA 4, ompF -1; heat 46 C: dnaK 4.5, groL 3, ibpA 6, ompF -2) with sample-level input variation and technical noise. Amplification efficiency is 2 for every gene.

    Usage

    qpcr_sim

    Format

    A tibble with 432 rows and 6 columns:

    plate

    Plate ("plate_1" or "plate_2").

    sample

    Biological sample.

    treatment

    "control", "heat_42C" or "heat_46C".

    gene

    Gene name.

    replicate

    Technical replicate (1 to 3).

    ct

    Quantification cycle.

    Source

    Simulated with a fixed seed in data-raw/make_data.R.

    Examples

    qpcr_sim
#> # A tibble: 216 × 6
#>    plate   sample    treatment gene  replicate    ct
#>    <chr>   <chr>     <chr>     <chr>     <int> <dbl>
#>  1 plate_1 control_1 control   gapA          1  17.8
#>  2 plate_1 control_1 control   gapA          2  17.6
#>  3 plate_1 control_1 control   gapA          3  17.8
#>  4 plate_1 control_1 control   rpoD          1  23.1
#>  5 plate_1 control_1 control   rpoD          2  23.1
#>  6 plate_1 control_1 control   rpoD          3  23.0
#>  7 plate_1 control_1 control   dnaK          1  25.0
#>  8 plate_1 control_1 control   dnaK          2  25.2
#>  9 plate_1 control_1 control   dnaK          3  25.3
#> 10 plate_1 control_1 control   groL          1  22.0
#> # ℹ 206 more rows
